results.name: NNReal.rpow_add_rpow_le
results.source_text:
theorem rpow_add_rpow_le {p q : ℝ} (a b : ℝ≥0) (hp_pos : 0 < p) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    (a ^ q + b ^ q) ^ (1 / q) ≤ (a ^ p + b ^ p) ^ (1 / p) := by
  have h_rpow : ∀ a : ℝ≥0, a ^ q = (a ^ p) ^ (q / p) := fun a => by
    rw [← NNReal.rpow_mul, div_eq_inv_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hp_pos.ne.symm,
      one_mul]
  have h_rpow_add_rpow_le_add :
    ((a ^ p) ^ (q / p) + (b ^ p) ^ (q / p)) ^ (1 / (q / p)) ≤ a ^ p + b ^ p := by
    refine rpow_add_rpow_le_add (a ^ p) (b ^ p) ?_
    rwa [one_le_div hp_pos]
  rw [h_rpow a, h_rpow b, one_div p, NNReal.le_rpow_inv_iff hp_pos, ← NNReal.rpow_mul, mul_comm,
    mul_one_div]
  rwa [one_div_div] at h_rpow_add_rpow_le_add

results.name: Bound.pow_le_pow_right_of_le_one_or_one_le
results.source_text:
/-- `bound` lemma for branching on `1 ≤ a ∨ a ≤ 1` when proving `a ^ n ≤ a ^ m` -/
@[bound]
lemma Bound.pow_le_pow_right_of_le_one_or_one_le [ZeroLEOneClass M₀] [PosMulMono M₀]
    (h : 1 ≤ a ∧ n ≤ m ∨ 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 1 ∧ m ≤ n) :
    a ^ n ≤ a ^ m := by
  obtain ⟨a1, nm⟩ | ⟨a0, a1, mn⟩ := h
  · exact pow_right_mono₀ a1 nm
  · exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one a0 a1 mn

results.name: Nat.dist.triangle_inequality
results.source_text:
theorem dist.triangle_inequality (n m k : ℕ) : dist n k ≤ dist n m + dist m k := by
  unfold Nat.dist; lia

results.name: Fintype.card
results.docstring: `card α` is the number of elements in `α`, defined when `α` is a fintype.

results.name: Fintype.finite
results.source_text:
protected theorem Fintype.finite {α : Type*} (_inst : Fintype α) : Finite α :=
  ⟨Fintype.equivFin α⟩

results.name: Fintype.card_finsupp
results.source_text:
@[simp] lemma Fintype.card_finsupp : card (ι →₀ α) = card α ^ card ι := by
  simp [card_congr Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite]

results.name: Cardinal.mk_finsupp_of_fintype
results.source_text:
theorem mk_finsupp_of_fintype (α β : Type u) [Fintype α] [Zero β] :
    #(α →₀ β) = #β ^ Fintype.card α := by simp

results.name: Fintype.card_zpowers
results.source_text:
/-- See also `Nat.card_zpowers`. -/
@[to_additive /-- See also `Nat.card_zmultiples`. -/]
theorem Fintype.card_zpowers : Fintype.card (zpowers x) = orderOf x :=
  (Fintype.card_eq.2 ⟨finEquivZPowers <| isOfFinOrder_of_finite _⟩).symm.trans <|
    Fintype.card_fin (orderOf x)

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.mathematicalPartitionFunction_of_fintype
results.source_text:
lemma mathematicalPartitionFunction_of_fintype [IsFinite 𝓒] (T : Temperature) :
    𝓒.mathematicalPartitionFunction T = ∑ i, exp (- β T * 𝓒.energy i) := by
  rw [mathematicalPartitionFunction_eq_integral, MeasureTheory.integral_fintype]
  simp [IsFinite.μ_eq_count]
  · rw [IsFinite.μ_eq_count]
    exact Integrable.of_finite

results.name: CanonicalEnsemble.partitionFunction_of_fintype
results.source_text:
lemma partitionFunction_of_fintype [IsFinite 𝓒] (T : Temperature) :
    𝓒.partitionFunction T = ∑ i, exp (- T.β * 𝓒.energy i) := by
  simp [partitionFunction, mathematicalPartitionFunction_of_fintype,
        IsFinite.dof_eq_zero, IsFinite.phase_space_unit_eq_one]
